Ava

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Cc: 
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Observability onboarding kickoff - TraceWire (internal prep)

Marissa / Ben —

Quick heads-up: TraceWire (HS-456789) is starting an onboarding with us. Kickoff Tue 11/10 10:00am PST. Customer asks include dashboards, tracing hooks, error taxonomy, and alert routing. Summary and asks below — can you confirm owners and what artifacts we can bring to the meeting?

Customer asks (short):
- 3 priority SLOs/KPIs (they'll provide but we should propose templates)
- PagerDuty escalation policy + who should be in integration (ops@tracewire.io)
- Trace span naming: they prefer service.operation-style spans and want resource tags for model_id + deployment_id

What I'd like from each of you before Wed EOD:
- Marissa: sample dashboard templates (latency histograms, p95/p99 by model), and a short runbook stub for partial-result errors. Attach as csv/xlsx.
- Ben: tracing hook guidance (sdk snippet, attribute names) and recommended alert thresholds for token queue depth and KV cache misses. Include small code snippet and example OTLP config.

Attachments we expect to produce: redwood-observability-template.csv, tracewire-kpis.xlsx, runbook-stub.md

Other notes: we should propose a staged rollout: dev -> canary -> prod with canary traffic split and automatic fallback to a smaller model if latency SLO is breached.

Thanks — Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Observability onboarding kickoff - TraceWire (internal prep)

Rafael —

Attached are the initial artifacts. High-level notes:

1) Dashboards (redwood-observability-template.csv / tracewire-kpis.xlsx)
- Tabs: Overview (latency p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec), Model breakdown (per-model p95 + error rate), Alertage (open alerts by severity)
- Suggested widgets: RL latency heatmap, token throughput timeseries by deployment, recent error log sample panel (linked to traces)

2) Runbook stub (runbook-stub.md) — includes:
- Trigger: partial outputs or repeated generation errors > 3/min for 5m
- Immediate action: revert canary traffic, clear KV cache for affected deployment, engage model-owner on slack #model-ops
- Triage steps: collect trace IDs, attach traces to ticket, escalate to SRE after 15m if unresolved

3) Tracing guidance (Ben's input inline)
- Span naming: service.operation (e.g., inference.generate, kv.cache_hit)
- Attributes: model_id, deployment_id, request_id, user_tier, prompt_length, token_count
- OTLP config: sample rate 10% for dev, 50% for canary, 100% for prod critical paths. See Ben's snippet in the trace guidance doc.

Next steps I recommend we bring the dashboard CSV to the kickoff so TraceWire can point to widgets they'd like. I put conservative alert thresholds in the sheet; we can iterate live.

Attachments: redwood-observability-template.csv (CSV), tracewire-kpis.xlsx (XLSX), runbook-stub.md (MD)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
